summary: All 6 acceptance criteria exercised: 1 backend test file (4 tests) + 6 named browser checks. All passed; two initial browser runs were flaky due to rapid back-to-back test-tool runs sharing one browser profile/localStorage, both passed cleanly on rerun (isolated) and are classified flaky, not app bugs.

checks.criterion: Checking still correct for all three designs
checks.name: test_tscheck_puzzle_generation.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/puzzles/new?topology={series_parallel,parallel_branch,series_parallel_series} -> 200; each solution row satisfies E=I*R and P=E*I within 1% tolerance; given_cells reference non-null given values. GET ?topology=tscheck-not-a-topology -> 422. 4 passed in 0.71s.

checks.criterion: Bug fix: entries persist after leaving and returning
checks.name: entries-persist-after-reload
checks.evidence: Typed into 2 inputs, reload kept same data-topology and same values; opened a second page in same context -> same topology and same values shown. First attempt was flaky (topology mismatch after reload) due to overlapping test runs sharing localStorage; passed on 2 clean reruns, including once on the preview URL (entries-persist-preview-url).

checks.criterion: Check results and revealed solution persist
checks.name: check-and-reveal-persist-after-reload
checks.evidence: Check Answers -> validation-summary-badge + input data-status set; Reveal Solution -> worked-solution-card visible; after reload all three (badge text, data-status, worked-solution-card) unchanged.

checks.criterion: Puzzle does not change on its own
checks.name: puzzle-stable-across-reload-and-visibility
checks.evidence: 3x reload kept identical data-topology; simulated document visibilitychange hidden->visible left data-topology unchanged.

checks.name: new-puzzle-replaces-and-clears
checks.evidence: After filling + checking, btn-new-puzzle produced a different data-topology, cleared the input and removed validation-summary-badge; reload after that kept the NEW topology.

checks.name: clear-empties-persistently
checks.evidence: btn-clear-inputs emptied 2 filled inputs; reload kept same topology and both inputs still empty.

checks.criterion: Checking still correct for all three designs
checks.name: checking-correct-for-all-designs
checks.evidence: Captured live GET /api/puzzles/new network responses while cycling New Puzzle; filled all 15 non-given inputs with the exact solution values for each of series_parallel, parallel_branch and series_parallel_series; validation-summary-badge showed '15 / 15' for all three.
